7z.description: Per-file CRCs and sizes sit in the header at the end of the archive, LZMA-compressed by default (kEncodedHeader). One LZMA decode of the header, independent of the archive size, gives them. Python's lzma is an optional module.

cd-sector.description: User data of a CD sector. In a 2048-byte image (.iso) sector N starts at N * 2048. In a raw 2352-byte image it starts at N * 2352 plus 16 for Mode 1 and plus 24 for Mode 2 Form 1 (12 sync bytes, a 4-byte header, and for Mode 2 an 8-byte subheader).

chd-v5.description: MAME compressed hunks, big-endian. The header holds sizes, codecs and hashes only, never the system or the region. The overall SHA-1 is what MAME software lists record. Neither SHA-1 equals a Redump track hash: chdman hashes 2448-byte frames (subcode included, zero-filled), pads each track to 4 frames and byte-swaps audio, all tracks in one stream.

metadata_entry.description: 16-byte entry header, payload follows. Linked list from metadata_offset.

gamecube-disc.description: Where disc offset 0 sits inside each container Dolphin opens.

gcz.note: block 0 is zlib unless bit 63 of its pointer is set

rvz.note: first 0x80 disc bytes copied into header 2

wia.note: first 0x80 disc bytes copied into header 2

iso9660.description: Primary volume descriptor in sector 16 ('CD001' at offset 1), root directory record at PVD offset 156 (34 bytes). A file is found by name in the root directory, with the ';1' version suffix.

zip.description: The central directory gives each member's CRC-32 (offset 16) and uncompressed size (offset 24) without inflating. Python's zipfile reads it on open (ZipInfo.CRC, ZipInfo.file_size).
